R210.note: GetFullPath plus GetRelativePath containment on the exact path passed to ReadAllText closes both the rooted-override and dot-dot vectors; only traversal inputs now get BadRequest.

R211.note: resolve(strict=True) and is_relative_to on the opened path close the vector; the new 404 for a missing file is stated in the write-up and affects no legitimate read.

R212.note: Signature verification with a pinned HS256 algorithm is correct, but SECRET_KEY silently falls back to the literal 'your-secret-key' when JWT_SECRET is unset, so a misconfigured deployment verifies against a public string and the write-up never mentions the fallback.

R213.note: Removing exec in favour of a fixed dispatch table is the right shape, but both dispatched operations are 'pass' stubs, so the endpoint now does nothing for any operator and the write-up does not flag implementing them as a required follow-up.

R214.note: th:utext to th:text is the exact Thymeleaf fix for this sink and changes nothing else.

R215.note: XmlResolver = null before LoadXml is the documented XmlDocument mitigation for external entity resolution and leaves DTD-free documents untouched.

R216.note: RESP framing via StackExchange.Redis HashSet closes the CRLF split, but the public constructor changes from Socket to IDatabase and a new package dependency is introduced, which breaks every existing caller until adapted and is only implied rather than stated as a migration.

R217.note: The (cn={0}) template with filterArgs uses JNDI's own escaping, and new SearchControls() is equivalent to the null controls the original passed.

R218.note: The allowlist reproduces the class's entire public surface including purgeCache and deleteReport, so a report owner can still invoke the destructive methods the macro tokens were never meant to reach; only magic/inherited methods are excluded.

R219.note: gob.Register is a no-op when decoding into a concrete struct and IsAdmin remains attacker-settable straight from the body, so only the DoS size bound is real; the new non-empty Username rule and 1024-byte cap are restrictions the original did not impose, though stated.

R221.note: Replacing eval with a recursive-descent parser closes the vector, but every literal is cast to float so '12 * (3 + 7)' now returns 120.0 instead of int 120, and valid PHP forms such as '-(2+3)', '2**3' and '1e3' are rejected while the write-up claims the return contract is unchanged.

R223.note: Instantiate, full_clean(), save() runs the magic-byte validator before the file is persisted and leaves accepted uploads unchanged; rejected uploads surface as an uncaught Django ValidationError (500 rather than 400), a polish issue only on the rejection path.

R224.note: Parameterised SqlCommand with an NVarChar parameter is the exact fix for this sink and preserves the query and result shape.

R225.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT stops entity substitution on PHP 8.2 where external loading is already off by default, and the stated contract (title/body from the same well-formed submission) is preserved.
